Custom skills: when the description matches, LeQi runs the steps automatically
A skill is a playbook (SKILL.md). When a skill description matches, LeQi loads its full steps first, then calls the local tools below to run them; multiple skills can be combined in one request
When off, no custom skill participates in chat
No skills yet. Tap a button above to add your first skill.
Delete skill \"%1$s\"? This cannot be undone.
Starts with a lowercase letter; only lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens (2-32 chars), e.g. weather-advice
One sentence on what it does + when to trigger, e.g. use when the user asks whether today is good for a run

# Steps 1. Call get_current_time to check what day of the week it is 2. Call search_web to check today\'s weather 3. Suggest clothes and hydration based on the feels-like temperature, reply in no more than 3 sentences
The steps may reference the available tools: time, knowledge base, web search, music, timer, ADB, etc. (up to %1$d chars)
Download a skill from a link

Search imported documents (manuals, notes) for answers when the question involves them
Answer time questions like \"what time is it\", \"what\'s today\'s date\", \"day of week\"
Check remaining battery of glasses, answer \"battery left\", \"need charging?\"
Query glasses system info (model, manufacturer, OS version, SDK version, serial)
Query glasses storage usage (used, available space)
List apps installed on glasses, answer \"which apps are installed\"
Open an app installed on glasses, answer \"open Xiaozhi\", \"open browser\", \"open game\"
Create timed reminders/tasks, answer \"remind me in 5 minutes\", \"wake me at 8am\", \"open Xiaozhi at 5pm\"
Play a requested song, answer \"play some song\", \"play something by an artist\"
Stop currently playing music, answer \"stop playing\", \"turn it off\", \"enough music\"

Bring up the lyric page on Rokid glasses. Lyrics are pushed automatically via Bluetooth AVRCP during playback; this tool only opens / re-triggers the lyric page. Triggered by \"show lyrics\", \"open lyrics\"

Read full info about the current song (title, artist, album, cover URL, line-by-line lyrics and playback position) as JSON text. AIUI player pages use it to render the cover and lyrics; also answers \"what song is playing\", \"show me the cover\"

Show an image: rendered in the phone-side chat bubble by default; if the glasses are connected it is also mirrored to a glasses overlay (~12s, auto-dismiss). Pass a public image URL (http/https) and optional caption; if the user just asks to show the current song cover, the URL can be omitted. Triggered by \"show image\", \"show cover\", etc.
Search the web for information, answer \"search for XXX\", \"find the latest info about XXX\"
Read the article content of a specific webpage link, used with web search to summarize pages
Save the summarized content as a txt file and import it into the knowledge base, answer \"save summary as txt/file\"
Write generated code/page files into the project folder in the phone download directory, answer \"write code\" \"generate page/app\" etc.
Read current source files of a chat-generated project, used with \"Save Code File\" to modify existing code/pages
Open an AIUI agent app on the glasses (e.g. \"Music Player\" \"Weather\"), answer \"open Music Player\" \"open an agent\" etc.
Package an AIUI project generated via code files into .aix and install it on the glasses, answer \"install this project on the glasses\" etc.
Close the AIUI agent app currently shown on the glasses, answer \"exit AIUI\" \"close this AI app\" \"go back\" etc. Works without knowing the app name.
List AIUI agent apps generated/uploaded on this device, answer \"which AI apps did I make\" \"my earlier AIUI\" etc.
List all current timer tasks, answer "what reminders do I have" etc.
Cancel/delete an existing timer task, answer "cancel that reminder" etc.
Let the AI gather info on its own and speak up when the time comes (e.g. "brief me on weather and schedule every morning"); read-only tools only
Query current weather and forecast for a city, answer "how is the weather today" etc.
Evaluate arithmetic expressions precisely (large numbers, power, parentheses)
Find contacts and phone numbers by name, answer "what is Zhang San's number" etc.
Open the phone dialer with a contact or number, answer "call Zhang San" etc.
Set alarm/timer on the phone, answer "wake me at 7am" "remind me on my phone in 30min" etc.
Open an installed app on the phone, answer "open WeChat on my phone" etc.
Query phone battery/charging/volume/brightness, answer "how much battery" etc.
Get the current phone location (city/street/landmark), answer "where am I" etc.
Set phone media volume by percentage, answer "set volume to 50" etc.
Query calendar events of a day, answer "what's on my schedule tomorrow" etc.
Create a calendar event on the phone, answer "note a meeting tomorrow 3pm" etc.
Query own runtime status: model, glasses connection, knowledge base / memory / skills counts, disabled tools
Read recent runtime logs to diagnose failures, answer "why did that fail" etc.
Discard the resume record of the pending task (generated files are kept)
Keyword search over past chat history, answer "what was that task we discussed" etc.

Tip: Ollama runs inside Termux — do not swipe Termux away from Recents (that kills Ollama). Lab wakes Termux automatically only when the service drops. If Termux notifications bother you, tap "Turn off Termux notifications" below once the service is running (the service keeps working).
Guard active: silent probing, no interruptions; Termux is woken only when the service drops

Missing the "Run commands in Termux" permission: grant it in system settings (Additional permissions). If it still fails afterwards, open Termux settings
Startup timed out: make sure ollama is installed in Termux (pkg install ollama) and external apps are allowed
Install command copied. Paste it into Termux and run it
Voice chat on glasses is using %1$s, fully offline with no internet needed
Not connected yet: pick a model below to use it for glasses chat offline
Applied immediately to every local chat request; still effective after switching models
Caps the output tokens per turn. Thinking models like qwen3 can over-think and make you wait; lowering this bounds the reply time
History tokens kept: larger remembers longer chats but uses more memory and a slower first token
Lower is steadier and more conservative, higher is more random
No models installed yet.\nTap Pull model to download one (start with a small 0.5B-1.5B model)
Start small: 0.5b-1.5b fits most phones; 3b and above need plenty of RAM
